apps.label: OpenCode
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Needs a phone review for scrolling, input, and approval prompts.

apps.label: Herdr
apps.mobile_notes: Official installer rejects native Termux/Android. Use a supported Linux host over SSH. Mouse-first panes and persistent agents are documented upstream; touchscreen use is unverified.

apps.label: Hunk
apps.mobile_notes: Upstream documents mouse navigation and unified diffs in narrow terminals. Prebuilt targets do not include Android. Native Termux and phone touch targets remain unverified.

apps.label: GitHub CLI
apps.mobile_notes: Termux maintains a gh package. Sign in with gh auth login. Phone interaction is not yet verified.

apps.label: lazygit
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Check mouse targets and narrow layouts on a phone.

apps.label: Yazi
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Check tap navigation and external editor handoff.

apps.label: micro
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Modeless editing; check selection and the software keyboard.

apps.label: Helix
apps.mobile_notes: Keyboard-heavy. Included for users who prefer modal editing, not verified touch-first.

apps.label: Neovim
apps.mobile_notes: Keyboard-heavy. Familiar to Neovim users, but modal commands and key chords can be awkward with a phone software keyboard.

apps.label: GitUI
apps.mobile_notes: Keyboard-heavy candidate. Needs a phone review.

apps.label: Zellij
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Review nested multiplexer input and graphics compatibility.

apps.label: bottom
apps.mobile_notes: Candidate. Review readability and narrow-screen layouts.
